summary: Tested new SIS Secondary Sales report (backend + frontend). Backend: 20 of 21 pytest cases pass (95%). All /api/sis/meta, /filters (cascading), /sales-report (defaults, till_date, latest_wk, latest_month, multi-level group_by, pagination, sorting, invalid group_by fallback, filter combinations, search) and /export (csv+xlsx with Total row and columns restriction) work. /api/sis/reload correctly returns 403 for ops. FAIL: /api/ask/help section 'sis' contains only 15 non-alias items but the spec (and the UI TOC user-facing count target) expects 20 — 5 measure help cards missing. Frontend: /sis-sales renders full hero bar, filter bar, table with 8 cluster-manager rows + totals row, hierarchy multi-level selectors change dims, till_date/latest_month/latest_wk toggles work (till-date flips NSV Growth to +54%), partner slicer opens panel and applies filter, sort URL param updates and arrow icon appears, column sets sales/finance/all switch columns, column chooser hides columns, drill button adds filter to URL, CSV + XLSX export requests return 200 with correct content-types, mgmt user can access, sis-reset clears URL. Help TOC shows 'SIS Secondary Sales Report · 15' (should be 20 per spec).

minor.issue: SIS_REPORT section has only 15 non-alias items; spec requires 20. Missing 5 concept cards under section 'sis' (help_content.py line 100-119). Affects Help TOC count and user-facing help coverage.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the centre of column header triggers the embedded HelpLink (navigates to /help) instead of sorting; sort only works when clicking near the left edge or on the arrow area. Automated tests hit /help by default. Consider e.stopPropagation on HelpLink (already there) but hit target overlaps — recommend wrapping label text in a separate clickable span for sort and keeping HelpLink outside the sort click zone.
sis-reset only clears URL search params — it does NOT reset local React state 'hidden' (columns hidden via chooser) or 'colMode'. After hiding a column via chooser + Reset, the column stays hidden.

issues: 'SIS Secondary Sales Report · 15' — expected · 20 per spec (backend content missing 5 items)

action_items: Add 5 missing non-alias help cards to SIS_REPORT in /app/backend/services/help_content.py so section 'sis' has 20 non-alias entries (current: sis-report, s-hierarchy, s-slicers, s-till-date, s-nsv, s-cont_pct, s-nsv_g, s-ltl_g, s-str, s-panel, s-est, s-est_g, s-prod, s-qty, s-finance = 15). Candidates likely: s-drill, s-total-row, s-column-sets, s-sort, s-export etc.
SisTable: prevent HelpLink from overlapping the sort click zone (wrap label in its own clickable span or add stopPropagation and larger sort target).
SisSales reset button should also clear the local 'hidden' and 'colMode' state so hidden columns re-appear.
critical_code_review_comments: sis_report.py aggregate() runs 6 group stages over 218k docs for every request — heavy queries (store_name,article_name) take ~10s. Consider adding indexes on store_code, article_name, and precomputing rollups.
sis_report.py build_match() int() cast on week list will 500 if a caller passes non-numeric week — should be guarded.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all major flows work; 2 minor UX bugs noted)

seed_data_creation: none — used existing sis_sales fact (218,447 rows)
context_for_next_testing_agent: SIS backend fully verified via /app/backend/tests/test_sis_report.py — run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var. Heavy group_bys (store_name,article_name) need ~10s wait in UI tests. Pagination via sis-next works but requires 10-12s wait for re-fetch. Column chooser and column-set state is local React state (not URL), so reset button does not clear it. Help alias flash class is removed after 2000ms — check within 2s if verifying help-flash.
rca of the issue: help_content.py SIS_REPORT list literally has 15 non-alias objects and 24 alias-only objects (7 inline + 19 appended in for-loop at line 121). Spec expected 20 non-alias cards, so 5 concept/measure cards need to be authored and appended before the alias for-loop.
